introHtml: Custom 46 oz wine accessories are ideal for events where you want to serve wine by the bottle without the bottle. This generous capacity holds a full standard wine bottle plus some, making it perfect for picnics, corporate retreats, or hospitality suites. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or engraving on stainless steel options for a polished, professional look that stands out.
